title: The Blood Pressure row and every blood-test row say their target without the unit their value page shows, and adding it wraps at 375px in SI
evidence: Found in PR 1710 (H83), real WebKit at 375 and 390, iPhone 13 profile. Each value page prints rowTarget's full line with its unit; the row prints bare with none and the unit under the value (US-62 AC8/AC9). Written into a row's meta line with a date, each of these takes two lines at 375: "Target <120/80 mmHg · Aug 2026", "Target <130/80 mmHg · Aug 2026", "Optimal <1.4 mmol/L · Aug 2026", "Normal <39 mmol/mol · Aug 2026", "Optimal <135 mg/dL · Aug 2026", "Optimal >1.0/>1.3 mmol/L · Aug 2026", "Normal 60–110/45–90 µmol/L · Aug 2026", "Normal 0.7–1.2/0.5–1.0 mg/dL · Aug 2026". Only US HbA1c "Normal <5.7% · Aug 2026" fits. Rows checked: Blood Pressure, HbA1c, LDL, total cholesterol, HDL, triglycerides, creatinine, ApoB, Lp(a). Waist got its unit in PR 1710, since its row shows the target alone. (H103)
